Guides / Pokémon / Abilities

Abilities

All 310 abilities and which Pokémon have them.

Every Pokémon has one ability, fixed for life by its personality: one of its two regular abilities, or its hidden ability (a 5% chance when there is one). Abilities work in battle much like the main games (Intimidate, Levitate, Flash Fire, Drought…). Flame Body, Magma Armor and Steam Engine also warm eggs twice as fast at the Day Care.

The full, searchable ability list is in the live wiki. Open this page in the live wiki to use it.
